selected_activity:
Activity: Participatory Council Hearing: Competency Level 8.1.1 (Period 2 of 2)
Approach: Students conduct a simulated community forum addressing 'Presents views appreciating the importance of public services of the times.'. Teams act as ward citizens, community elders, and public officers to present and debate solutions.
Student task: Draft 2-minute citizen statements, propose municipal priorities, and vote on a community resolution.
Teacher facilitation: Acts as meeting speaker, moderates speaking turns, and enforces time limits.
Expected output: Approved 3-point citizen resolution sheet recorded in notebooks.
Grouping: 8 teams (8 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
